points.quote: Each document is a `Y.Doc`, and the block tree lives inside it as Yjs types.
Incoming change: it applies the update to the `Y.Doc` as a remote-origin change. The editor then renders it.
the stored form is binary Yjs update/snapshot blobs, not JSON.
Awareness (cursors and presence) has its own cloud channel.
Web (IndexedDB): one database per workspace, named `workspace:${id}`... Desktop and mobile: `impls/sqlite` stores the same kind of data in SQLite
Local edit: it saves the edit's update to local storage and hands it to the sync layer.
